Sample.evidence_source: A total of 63 interviews were conducted for the 23 suicides with 34 relatives, 17 family doctors and 12 home-based care nurses.

Population.evidence_source: The aim was to have two or three informants for each suicide: close relatives, their family doctor, and the home-based nurse/home help (if relevant). The prerequisite for participating in the interview was that the informants had had close contact with the elderly person – as relatives or as his/her family doctor for a long period (years) – or had had regular contact during the last year of life as a homebased care nurse or home help.

Type.evidence_source: A total of 63 interviews were conducted for the 23 suicides with 34 relatives, 17 family doctors and 12 home-based care nurses.
